allow: PowerShell(foreach \($id in 12712, 10044, 13408, 13300, 2972\) { try { Stop-Process -Id $id -Force -ErrorAction Stop; "Detenido PID $id" } catch { "PID $id ya no existe" } })

PowerShell($p = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='node.exe'"; if \($p\) { $p | Select-Object ProcessId, CommandLine | Format-List } else { "No quedan procesos node.exe" }; "--- Puertos 3000 / 3117 ---"; $c = Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -in 3000,3117 }; if \($c\) { $c | Select-Object LocalPort, OwningProcess | Format-Table -AutoSize } else { "Libres" })
